dedupe_keys.name: mobility database gtfs gtfs realtime and gbfs catalogue

description: Mobility Database is a global catalogue maintained by MobilityData. Its public inventories, read on 7 October 2026, list 6,591 GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds and 1,540 GBFS shared-mobility entries. Transit rows include 4,684 active feeds; inactive, deprecated, future and development listings are retained with separate statuses. The GBFS inventory has no equivalent operating-status column. The metadata identify providers or systems, locations, feed endpoints and selected authentication or licence information. The website and CSV inventories are publicly accessible, while API access requires an account. Underlying feed licences, restrictions and costs depend on their providers. Researchers can use the catalogue to find timetable, transport-network and shared-mobility inputs for infrastructure simulation. A listing does not establish that an endpoint works, that a service is operating, or that every data field is current. Our records may group several feeds under one provider or dataset; the completion ledger preserves each source row and any predecessor relationship. Related resource records retain their individual access links. No transit archives or station and vehicle observations were downloaded for this metadata collection.
licence: Underlying feed licences vary by provider; consult each listing and provider terms
